messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — proposing the GA "goalposts" + a small delta plan so we can close scope. Need alignment on SLA, docs, support/runbooks, monitoring, and pricing before EOD Fri. TL;DR: propose hosted SLA 99.95% availability, latency SLOs by request size, docs ready next Tue, canary rollout + monitoring + pricing bands. Assign owners below. :rocket:

Ajay Patel: thanks — quick Q: when you say "latency SLOs by request size" do you mean separate 95th targets for short vs long sequences? also: committed vs on-demand pricing bands?

Maria Chen: yes to both. thinking: small requests (<=128 tokens) 95th <250ms for hosted; medium (129-1024) 95th <600ms; long sequences best-effort but <1.5s 95th. Dedicated capacity will have a tighter throughput SLA but looser latency guarantees for very long contexts. Pricing: 3 bands (on-demand, reserved monthly commit, enterprise committed) with clear delta table.

Leo Gomez: flag: 250ms 95th is doable for smaller models and optimized kernels, but depends on model + quantization. we should matrix SLO by model class (small/medium/large). also need to validate under steady-state multitenant load — recommend a 2-week soak on canary infra.

Maria Chen: agreed — we will create an SLO matrix by model class. owners: Ajay -> validate SLA metrics & test plan; Leo -> runtime validation + soak; Olivia -> docs; Support Ops -> runbook & escalation; Kai deploy bot -> handles canary scheduling.

Olivia Park: docs note — I'll draft Quickstart, Migration guide from beta, and a Pricing FAQ. can you confirm the canonical location where runbook links need to land?

Maria Chen: put runbooks under /runbooks/ga-ready and we will link from the public docs. Olivia, target draft by Tue COB.

Ajay Patel: propose canary rollout plan: stage 1 = 1% traffic for 12h (smoke), stage 2 = 5% for 24h (burn-in), stage 3 = 25% for 48h (load), then ramp to GA. rollback triggers: sustained 95th > baseline * 1.5 for 15m OR error-rate > 0.5% absolute for 10m.

Leo Gomez: monitoring specifics: dashboards with token-level cost, 50/90/95/99 latency, per-model error rate, request queue depth, KV cache hit rate. alerts: paging to oncall when 95th jumps >50% vs rolling baseline OR error-rate spike. add synthetic checks for endpoint correctness every 5m.

Kai (deploy-bot): canary plan scheduled: 4823457000 -> stage1 (1%), 4823540000 -> stage2 (5%), 4823700000 -> stage3 (25%). Automated rollback enabled.

Support Ops: runbook gap — we need explicit billing dispute steps and pricing escalation contacts (Finance rep + Sales AE). Also need a short troubleshooting checklist for customers (latency vs throttling vs model mismatch).

Maria Chen: ok — Ajay + Finance for pricing escalation contacts. Support Ops to author the customer troubleshooting checklist; Olivia to include it in the public FAQ.

Ajay Patel: pricing proposal (high level): on-demand = baseline per-token rate; reserved monthly commit = 20% discount; annual enterprise = custom with SLAs and committed capacity pricing. also add an overage protection for bursts (burst buffer for first 72h / month).

Olivia Park: will include pricing table + example invoices and escalation email templates in docs. I need final numbers from Finance by Tue morning.

Maria Chen: Acceptance checklist (working) — please validate items and owners: ```- SLA matrix published (per-model class) - Runtime tests: soak 2 weeks on canary - Monitoring: dashboards + synthetic checks in prod - Alerts: paging thresholds documented - Docs: Quickstart, Migration, Pricing FAQ, Troubleshooting - Runbooks: oncall playbook + billing escalation + rollback steps - Canary rollout plan scheduled - Pricing bands signed off by Finance``` Owners: Ajay, Leo, Olivia, Support Ops, Finance.

Leo Gomez: I'll add technical acceptance criteria to the runtime tests: cold-start median, KV cache hit >= 60% on representative workload, sustained throughput at target qps with <1% error.

Support Ops: we'll draft the oncall playbook and billing escalation flow. can we get a 1-pager to hand to L1s?

Maria Chen: yes — Support Ops produce 1-pager L1 + full runbook. Olivia will link both from public docs.

Ajay Patel: next steps / owners & due dates: Ajay - SLA test plan + pricing draft (Tue 11:59am), Leo - runtime validation plan + soak schedule (start Wed), Olivia - docs draft (Tue COB), Support Ops - L1 1-pager + runbook draft (Wed COB), Finance - pricing numbers (Tue morning).

Maria Chen: good. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or call out disagreements here. aiming to lock scope by EOD Fri so we can start canary next Wed.

Olivia Park: :thumbsup:

Ajay Patel: :thumbsup:

Leo Gomez: :eyes: will follow up with the detailed test harness plan by EOD today.

Support Ops: :thumbsup: will start runbook draft and ping for billing contacts.

Maria Chen: thanks all — I'll synthesize this into a single checklist doc and share in #product later today. :wave:
